description: 방송미디어통신위원회_시청자평가지수(KI)정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 방송미디어통신위원회. 방미통위와 정보통신정책연구원이 수행하는 시청자평가지수(KI) 조사는 1년에 4차례, 총 4만8,000명의 온라인 패널을 대상으로 하며 KI 지수는 ‘프로그램의 만족도’와 ‘질적 우수성. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 방송미디어통신위원회. Its tags are 프로그램 평가지수, 만족도 지수, 시청자평가, KI, 품질. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
